messages:
Maya (docs): Hi team — opened a docs PR updating the audit-log examples and SDK snippet to show redaction + configurable retention. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2146

Priya (security): Thanks. Can we avoid hardcoding '7 years' or any fixed retention? For SOC 2 we should say 'retention policy configurable; default 90 days; enterprise options available'. Also add redaction example for emails/SSNs.

Evan (legal): Agree w/ Priya. Also we should not state specific SOC 2 controls; keep it high-level: "supports SOC 2 requirements for audit trails" not "SOC 2 compliant". Remove any definitive compliance claims.

Tom (sdk): Putting a quick SDK snippet in the PR — do we want the audit event property to be `audit_event` or `auditEvent`? Current client libs use snake_case.

Maya (docs): Use snake_case to match existing SDKs. I added snippet using `audit_event`.

Tom (sdk): Snippet:
```
# python
client.audit.log(
  audit_event={
    "event_type": "file.upload",
    "user_id": "user-1234",
    "details": {
      "file_name": "report.pdf",
      "uploader_email": "<REDACTED_EMAIL>"
    }
  },
  retention_days=90
)
```

Priya (security): Replace "<REDACTED_EMAIL>" with a redaction guideline comment like "uploader_email: REDACTED: email removed per policy" — we also need to document which fields are considered PII by default (email, ssn, phone).

Evan (legal): Also add a sentence: "Customers control retention duration; Redwood does not access PII for product analytics." — but check with security before publishing.

DocsBot: link-checker found one broken link -> line 42: /docs/old-audit-api.md

Maya (docs): Thanks bot. I'll update the link to /docs/audit-logs/reference and ping when done.

Liam (engineering): Minor nit: the sample JSON in the PR has a trailing comma in the code block which fails lint. I'll push a tiny fix.

Priya (security): Once link + wording adjusted, I'm good to sign off. Evan, legal ok?

Evan (legal): LGTM aside from the compliance phrasing tweak. Approve after change.

Maya (docs): I'll make the wording change and merge after Priya confirms. ETA: today EOD. :thumbsup:
